events.label: birth
events.text: Born Myles Lynn Deering.

evidence.quote: Myles Lynn Deering ( born 1953 )

events.text: Enlisted in the United States Army Reserve.

evidence.quote: enlisted in the United States Army Reserve in October 1971

events.text: Transferred into the Texas Army National Guard.

evidence.quote: In 1974 , he transferred into the Texas Army National Guard

events.text: Entered Officer Candidate School program, Texas Army National Guard.

evidence.quote: In 1974 , he transferred into the Texas Army National Guard and entered the Officer Candidate School program

events.text: Commissioned second lieutenant in the 36th Infantry Brigade.

evidence.quote: He received his commission as a second lieutenant in 1976 in the 36th Infantry Brigade

events.text: Transferred to Oklahoma Army National Guard 45th Infantry Brigade.

evidence.quote: Lieutenant Deering then transferred to the Oklahoma Army National Guards 45th Infantry Brigade in 1977

events.text: Received Bachelor of Business Administration, University of Oklahoma.

evidence.quote: Deering received a Bachelor of Business Administration in Management from the University of Oklahoma in 1980

events.text: Promoted to captain.

evidence.quote: In March 1980 he was promoted to the rank of captain

events.text: Assumed command of Combat Support Company, 1st Battalion, 180th Infantry Regiment.

evidence.quote: In March 1980 he was promoted to the rank of captain and assumed command

events.text: Assigned to 45th Infantry Brigade headquarters as intelligence assistant.

evidence.quote: By December 1981 , Captain Deering was assigned to
the 45th Infantry Brigades headquarters where he served as an intelligence assistant

events.text: Became commander of Company C, 1st Battalion, 180th Infantry Regiment.

evidence.quote: In 1983 , Deering became the commander of Company C , 1st Battalion , 180th Infantry Regiment

events.text: Moved to 700th Support Battalion as executive officer.

evidence.quote: In May 1986 , Captain Deering moved to the 700th Support Battalion in Oklahoma City

events.text: Promoted to major.

evidence.quote: He was promoted to major in February 1988

events.text: Returned to 700th Support Battalion and assumed its command.

evidence.quote: Major Deering returned to the 700th Support Battalion in 1992

events.text: Promoted to lieutenant colonel.

evidence.quote: in 1992 and assumed command of that unit with his promotion to lieutenant colonel

events.text: Became executive officer of 45th Infantry Brigade.

evidence.quote: In June 1995 , Colonel Deering became the executive officer for the 45th Infantry Brigade

events.text: Received Master of Science, Oklahoma State University.

evidence.quote: He also received a Master of Science degree in Natural and Applied Sciences from Oklahoma State University in 1996

events.text: Promoted to full colonel.

evidence.quote: He was promoted to full colonel in July 1999

events.text: Received Master of Strategic Studies, US Army War College.

evidence.quote: a Master of Strategic Studies from the United States Army War College in 2000

events.text: Became Chief of the Joint Staff, Joint Force Headquarters.

evidence.quote: He would next serve as Chief of the Joint Staff for the Joint Force Headquarters in May 2003

events.text: Reassigned to 45th Infantry Brigade and assumed command as brigadier general.

evidence.quote: By December 2004 , Colonel Deering was reassigned to 45th Infantry Brigade and assumed command of the entire brigade

events.text: Promoted to brigadier general.

evidence.quote: with promotion in February 2005

events.text: Deployed to Iraq with 45th Brigade; commanded Joint Area Support Group-Central.

evidence.quote: In October 2007 , General Deering and the 45th Infantry Brigade were deployed to Iraq

events.text: Returned from Iraq deployment.

evidence.quote: He returned in November 2008

events.text: Promoted to major general.

evidence.quote: was promoted to major general on November 13 , 2008

events.text: Assigned as director, J-1, National Guard Bureau, Pentagon.

evidence.quote: promoted to major general on November 13 , 2008 , with his assignment as director

events.text: Appointed Adjutant General of Oklahoma by Governor Brad Henry.

evidence.quote: On February 3 , 2009 , Governor of Oklahoma Brad Henry appointed General Deering to become the Adjutant General of Oklahoma
General Deering was appointed by Governor of Oklahoma Brad Henry in 2009
He was appointed as the Adjutant General of the Oklahoma National Guard in February 2009

events.text: Governor-elect Fallin announced retention as adjutant general and secretary of military.

evidence.quote: On December 10 , 2010 , Governor-elect Mary Fallin announced that she would retain General Deering
On December 10 , 2010 , Governor-elect Mary Fallin announced that she would retain General Deering in his position as adjutant general

undated_mentions: Appointed Secretary of the Military by Governors Henry and Fallin (no date stated)
Briefly assigned to 45th Infantry Brigade headquarters after February 1988 promotion (no date stated)
Selected as secretary to the General Staff, Oklahoma National Guard headquarters (between 1995 and 1999; no date stated)
Assigned director of Human Resources Directorate, Oklahoma National Guard headquarters (no date stated)
Director for plans, operations and training, Oklahoma Army National Guard (no date stated)
Deployed to New Orleans as Joint Task Force commander after Hurricane Katrina and Rita (no date stated)
